pages.quiz:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 120 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the best way to respond when someone teases you about your appearance? (1 mark)
   A. Tease them back
   B. Stop going to school
   C. Remember that God made you special and tell a trusted adult if it continues
   D. Change your name

2. Which of these is a good use of your talents? (1 mark)
   A. Helping others with them
   B. Hiding them always
   C. Using them to hurt people
   D. Boasting about them

3. How can a smile help others? (1 mark)
   A. It has no effect
   B. It hurts them
   C. It can cheer up a person who is tired or sad
   D. It makes them angry

4. Which choice affects other people besides yourself? (1 mark)
   A. Littering the school compound
   B. Choosing your favourite colour
   C. Choosing which shoe to wear first
   D. Choosing a song you like

5. Which commandment says, "Honour your father and your mother"? (1 mark)
   A. Exodus 20:3
   B. Exodus 20:12
   C. Exodus 20:15
   D. Exodus 20:16

6. Which of these is a safe touch? (1 mark)
   A. Touching your private parts by a stranger
   B. A touch you have been told to keep secret
   C. A touch that scares you
   D. A hug from a parent

7. Which action shows that we care for God's creation? (1 mark)
   A. Planting trees and saving water
   B. Hurting animals
   C. Cutting trees for fun
   D. Wasting food

8. What does it mean to say that the Bible is inspired? (1 mark)
   A. God guided the writers so that their message is His word
   B. People invented it
   C. The writers copied other books
   D. It was written in one day

9. In the reference John 3:16, what does the number 16 stand for? (1 mark)
   A. The book
   B. The verse
   C. The page
   D. The chapter

10. Which of these is an honest use of money? (1 mark)
   A. Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   B. Cheating in a game
   C. Stealing from a friend
   D. Lying about the price

11. Where was Joseph when the cupbearer remembered him? (1 mark)
   A. In his father's house
   B. In the palace
   C. In prison
   D. In Canaan

12. What position did Pharaoh give Joseph? (1 mark)
   A. Shepherd
   B. Second in command over Egypt
   C. Soldier
   D. Priest

13. Which verse says that all peoples on earth will be blessed through Abraham? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 1:37
   B. John 3:16
   C. Genesis 1:1
   D. Genesis 12:3

14. Which verse says that nothing is impossible with God? (1 mark)
   A. Luke 7:14
   B. Luke 15:8
   C. Luke 1:37
   D. Luke 19:5

15. To whom was Mary engaged to be married? (1 mark)
   A. David
   B. Joseph
   C. Zechariah
   D. Simeon

16. Why could Zechariah not speak for a time? (1 mark)
   A. He was tired
   B. He did not believe the angel's words
   C. He was ill
   D. He was sad

17. Which of these helps to protect our eyes? (1 mark)
   A. Not rubbing them with dirty hands
   B. Staring at the sun
   C. Reading in the dark
   D. Throwing dust

18. Which Gospel records the healing of Bartimaeus? (1 mark)
   A. Romans
   B. Genesis
   C. Mark
   D. Acts

19. What is a miracle? (1 mark)
   A. A school lesson
   B. A festival
   C. An amazing act that shows God's power
   D. An ordinary meal

20. Which is a good first step when you are angry with someone? (1 mark)
   A. Shout at the person
   B. Plan revenge
   C. Calm down and breathe
   D. Break their things

21. What is revenge? (1 mark)
   A. Hurting someone because they hurt you
   B. Forgiving
   C. Praying
   D. Sharing

22. Which is the best way to give? (1 mark)
   A. Grumbling
   B. Laughing
   C. Boasting
   D. Cheerfully and respectfully

23. Where is the parable of the lost coin found? (1 mark)
   A. Acts 2:38
   B. John 3:16
   C. Genesis 12:1
   D. Luke 15:8-10

24. In the parable, who does the woman stand for? (1 mark)
   A. A sinner
   B. A shopkeeper
   C. A priest
   D. God

25. Which of these is a righteous way of living? (1 mark)
   A. Cheating
   B. Telling the truth
   C. Stealing
   D. Lying

26. Which of these helps God's kingdom grow? (1 mark)
   A. A good example and sharing the good news
   B. Ignoring church
   C. Being unkind
   D. Keeping quiet

27. What is baptism? (1 mark)
   A. A Christian act of washing with water in the name of Father, Son and Holy Spirit
   B. A meal
   C. A journey
   D. A dance

28. Who visited Jesus at night? (1 mark)
   A. Nicodemus
   B. Zacchaeus
   C. Samson
   D. Balaam

29. Which of these is dishonest? (1 mark)
   A. Copying in a test
   B. Admitting a mistake
   C. Returning lost money
   D. Saying sorry

30. Which is a benefit of obeying parents? (1 mark)
   A. Poor marks
   B. Lost trust
   C. Peace at home
   D. Trouble

31. Which action shows love? (1 mark)
   A. Sharing your lunch
   B. Ignoring
   C. Hurting
   D. Teasing

32. What came upon the disciples at Pentecost? (1 mark)
   A. A king
   B. The Holy Spirit
   C. An army
   D. A storm only

33. What is a warning sign of an unsafe group? (1 mark)
   A. It tells you to keep secrets from parents
   B. It encourages school work
   C. It welcomes you kindly
   D. It teaches good manners

34. Which verse warns about bad company? (1 mark)
   A. Genesis 1:1
   B. John 3:16
   C. Luke 1:37
   D. 1 Corinthians 15:33

35. In Matthew 6:5-6, how did Jesus say we should pray? (1 mark)
   A. Never
   B. Loudly to impress
   C. Sincerely, not to be seen by others
   D. Only in public

36. Which fruit is shown by making peace between quarrelling friends? (1 mark)
   A. Pride
   B. Greed
   C. Peace
   D. Laziness

37. Which verse compares a person without self-control to a broken city wall? (1 mark)
   A. Proverbs 25:28
   B. Acts 2:38
   C. Proverbs 1:7
   D. John 3:16

38. Which media can defile a child? (1 mark)
   A. Gospel songs
   B. Educational programmes
   C. Bible stories
   D. Violent and ungodly movies

39. Why should you not chat with strangers online? (1 mark)
   A. They may not be who they say they are
   B. They are always kind
   C. It is fun
   D. It is free

40. What is social media? (1 mark)
   A. A school
   B. Websites and apps that let people share messages, pictures and videos
   C. A market
   D. A newspaper

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
41. State three challenges that children may face and how they can involve God. (3 marks)

42. Explain what a child should do if a stranger contacts them online and why. (5 marks)

43. State three lessons from the story of Zacchaeus. (3 marks)

44. Explain how Ephesians 4:25 can be applied by a child in the classroom. (5 marks)

45. Explain what the story of Samson teaches and what it does not teach children to do. (5 marks)

46. Explain why the body is called a temple of the Holy Spirit. (3 marks)

47. Describe how Stephen died. (3 marks)

48. Explain what it means to repent as taught in Acts 2:38 and how a child can do it. (5 marks)

49. Explain how the books of the Old Testament are grouped, giving the number of books in each group. (5 marks)

50. What is a mustard seed like, and what does it grow into? (2 marks)

51. Give two ways of helping a person who is blind. (2 marks)

52. Explain why a Christian should behave well online even when nobody is watching. (3 marks)

53. State two ways in which Bartimaeus showed faith in Jesus. (2 marks)

54. Explain why obedience is important at home and at school, and when a child should not obey. (5 marks)

55. Describe the naming of John. (4 marks)

56. Outline three results of disobedience. (3 marks)

57. Name two fruits of the Holy Spirit listed in Galatians 5:22-23. (2 marks)
pages.answers:
CHRISTIAN RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. C — Remember that God made you special and tell a trusted adult if it continues
   God's view of you matters more than unkind words.

2. A — Helping others with them
   Talents are gifts from God meant to serve others.

3. C — It can cheer up a person who is tired or sad
   Small acts of kindness like a smile encourage others.

4. A — Littering the school compound
   Littering makes the compound dirty for everyone.

5. B — Exodus 20:12
   Exodus 20:12 is the commandment on honouring parents.

6. D — A hug from a parent
   A hug from a parent is safe and loving.

7. A — Planting trees and saving water
   Caring for the environment honours the Creator.

8. A — God guided the writers so that their message is His word
   2 Timothy 3:16 teaches that Scripture is inspired by God.

9. B — The verse
   In John 3:16, John is the book, 3 is the chapter, and 16 is the verse.

10. A — Returning extra change to a shopkeeper
   Honesty means returning what is not ours.

11. C — In prison
   Joseph was in prison in Egypt.

12. B — Second in command over Egypt
   Joseph was put in charge of Egypt, next to Pharaoh.

13. D — Genesis 12:3
   Genesis 12:3 contains this promise.

14. C — Luke 1:37
   Luke 1:37 is the memory verse of this topic.

15. B — Joseph
   Mary was engaged to Joseph of the house of David.

16. B — He did not believe the angel's words
   Luke 1:20 says he would be silent because he did not believe.

17. A — Not rubbing them with dirty hands
   Clean hands protect the eyes from infection.

18. C — Mark
   Mark 10:46-52 tells the story.

19. C — An amazing act that shows God's power
   Miracles show God's power.

20. C — Calm down and breathe
   Calming down helps you to choose wisely.

21. A — Hurting someone because they hurt you
   Revenge is paying back harm.

22. D — Cheerfully and respectfully
   Kind giving respects the person.

23. D — Luke 15:8-10
   The parable is in Luke 15:8-10.

24. D — God
   The searching woman stands for God's love.

25. B — Telling the truth
   Righteous living pleases God.

26. A — A good example and sharing the good news
   We help by our life and words.

27. A — A Christian act of washing with water in the name of Father, Son and Holy Spirit
   Baptism is a sign of new life.

28. A — Nicodemus
   John 3:1-2 says Nicodemus came at night.

29. A — Copying in a test
   Copying is cheating.

30. C — Peace at home
   Obedience brings harmony.

31. A — Sharing your lunch
   Sharing is practical love.

32. B — The Holy Spirit
   Acts 2 tells of the Holy Spirit.

33. A — It tells you to keep secrets from parents
   Secrets from parents are a warning.

34. D — 1 Corinthians 15:33
   Bad company corrupts good character.

35. C — Sincerely, not to be seen by others
   Jesus warned against showing off.

36. C — Peace
   Peace is a fruit.

37. A — Proverbs 25:28
   Proverbs 25:28.

38. D — Violent and ungodly movies
   Harmful media can affect the mind.

39. A — They may not be who they say they are
   People online can pretend.

40. B — Websites and apps that let people share messages, pictures and videos
   Social media lets people connect.

SECTION B
----
41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Illness, loss of a loved one, lack of school fees, bullying, exams. They can pray, trust God and ask trusted adults for help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid challenge with a way of involving God, up to 3.

42. (5 marks)
   Answer: They should not reply, should close the chat, should tell a parent or teacher, and can call 116. Strangers may pretend to be someone else and may want to harm the child. Telling a trusted adult keeps the child safe.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not replying, 1 for closing, 1 for telling an adult, 1 for the helpline, 1 for the reason.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: Jesus loves everyone, even those others reject; repentance means changing and putting things right; we should be honest with money and share with the poor.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid lesson.

44. (5 marks)
   Answer: Put off falsehood and speak truthfully because we are all members of one body. A child should not cheat, should admit mistakes, should not blame others, and should tell the teacher what really happened.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the verse meaning, 1 for not cheating, 1 for admitting mistakes, 1 for not blaming, 1 for telling the truth kindly.

45. (5 marks)
   Answer: It teaches that God is powerful, that strength and abilities are gifts from God, and that we should trust Him and be honest with parents. It does not teach children to fight lions or dangerous animals or to do dangerous things. Children should stay away from danger and call adults.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for God's power, 1 for gifts from God, 1 for trust and honesty, 1 for not fighting dangerous animals, 1 for staying safe.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: The Holy Spirit lives in believers, so the body is holy like a temple and should be treated with respect.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Holy Spirit, 1 for holy, 1 for respect.

47. (3 marks)
   Answer: The people were furious at his message, dragged him out of the city and stoned him. He prayed for God to receive his spirit and to forgive them.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for anger, 1 for stoning, 1 for prayer.

48. (5 marks)
   Answer: Repent means to be sorry for sin and turn away from it. Peter told people to repent and be baptised. A child can admit wrong, tell God sorry, ask forgiveness from others, make a decision to do better and ask the Holy Spirit's help.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the meaning, 1 for Acts 2:38, 1 for admitting, 1 for saying sorry, 1 for deciding to do better.

49. (5 marks)
   Answer: Law has 5 books, history has 12 books, poetry and wisdom has 5 books, and the prophets have 17 books. Together they make 39 books.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each group with number, and 1 mark for the total.

50. (2 marks)
   Answer: A very small seed that grows into a large tree.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

51. (2 marks)
   Answer: Greet them by name, offer to guide, include them, do not tease.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

52. (3 marks)
   Answer: God sees everything; integrity means doing right in private; good behaviour protects us and others.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each reason.

53. (2 marks)
   Answer: He called out to Jesus; he kept shouting when told to be quiet; he came at once; he asked for sight.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid way.

54. (5 marks)
   Answer: Obedience brings peace at home, safety and learning at school. It pleases God. A child should not obey instructions that are unsafe or hurt them or others. In that case they should say no and tell a trusted adult.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for home peace, 1 for school learning, 1 for pleasing God, 1 for not obeying harmful instructions, 1 for telling a trusted adult.

55. (4 marks)
   Answer: On the eighth day people wanted to call him Zechariah. Elizabeth said his name is John. They asked Zechariah, who wrote, "His name is John." His speech returned and he praised God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

56. (3 marks)
   Answer: Punishment, danger, loss of trust, guilt, poor marks.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each result.

57. (2 marks)
   Answer: Any two of love, joy, peace, patience, kindness, goodness, faithfulness, gentleness, self-control.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct fruit.
